description: This file defines the 'Identifier' model class in the Opencart framework, responsible for managing identifier records in the database, including CRUD operations.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: Model class for handling identifier records within the Opencart localisation module.

methods.name: addIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a new identifier record in the database and returns its primary key.

methods.name: editIdentifier
methods.description: Updates an existing identifier record based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteIdentifier
methods.description: Removes an identifier record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a specific identifier record by its ID.

methods.name: getIdentifierByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an identifier record based on its code.

methods.name: getIdentifiers
methods.description: Fetches multiple identifier records with optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalIdentifiers
methods.description: Returns the total count of identifier records in the database.
